description: Encodes text or a URL as a QR code. Returns a link to the image and the image itself. With the text format it returns the code as rows of 0 and 1 instead.

accuracy.description: Error-correction level. Higher levels survive more damage but produce denser codes.

bgcolor.description: Background colour as six hex digits, for example `ff6700`, or a decimal RGB integer. Default white.

color.description: Foreground colour as six hex digits, for example `ff6700`, or a decimal RGB integer. Default black.

content.description: The text or URL to encode, up to 4000 characters.

format.description: `png` (default), `jpg`, `svg`, or `text` for a 0/1 matrix in JSON.

padding.description: Quiet zone around the code in modules, 0 to 20. Default 2.

size.description: Pixels per QR module, from `1` to `20`.

name: generate_qr_code
title: Generate a QR code
